B1: PASS
Why: The synopsis states the reason, that "the controller relied entirely on the implementer's own report of passing tests… so a false claim went unchecked." It states the goal, that plan 84 "builds Design 1 of the spec on finding 21: independent test execution." Both match the spec's Intent and D1, and the synopsis correctly says the acceptance-test clause was dropped because plan 83 closed finding 24.
B2: PASS
Why: The order is kit and control arms at BASE, then `test-run`, then `task-done` calling it, then the controller's text, then the reviewer prompts that read the run file, then the records and retirement. No part comes before a part it needs. Diff fact 1: `test-run` "validates the task ID" before it builds any path (`skills/subagent-driven-development/scripts/test-run`, the `id_chars` case check). Diff fact 2: it "records HEAD and working-tree state" in the run header (same file: the `head_sha` and `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal` tree line). The spec states neither.
B3: PASS
Why: The synopsis names project-level dependencies and workflow changes: "SDD and executing-plans share one run script, so format changes reach both," and "Several prompts now depend on the run-file format." It also says "Every SDD review now rests on evidence the controller produced at a known commit and tree."
B4: PASS
Contradicted: none
